name: Ward County, ND
findings: Ward County has 199 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ward County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Ward County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
